info.title: OpenRent API
info.description: Every OpenRent feature is available here; the back office and storefront use the same endpoints. Money is `{amount, currency}` in minor units. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`. POST requests accept `Idempotency-Key`.
